messages:
taylor: Heads-up: Switch dock is missing from the gear locker. Anyone grabbed it after last week's indie co-op? 

sasha: Not me. I only took the joycons for testing. Where was it last seen? 

taylor: last seen next to the mezz couch, near the blue tote. Might've been moved during cleanup. 

ben: If we can't find it, I can bring my spare dock and a Switch Pro controller. Also down for a controller raffle if people want to chip in snacks. :pizza: 

rina: raffle sounds fun. 50/50: snacks or stickers as prize? :thinking_face: 

sasha: snacks always win. :raised_hands: Also can somebody check the office Lost & Found drawer? I put a few cables there before. 

game-bot: Inventory check requested by taylor. Action items: 1) search blue tote 2) check Lost & Found drawer 3) ben to bring spare if not found. 

taylor: thanks bot. Quick technical: if anyone brings a dock, pls bring an Ethernet adapter too (we'll hardline the host for Remote Play). 

ben: noted. i'll bring dock + adapter + a bag of chips for raffle seed. 

rina: i'm volunteering to run the raffle bracket at 8pm. small rules: one ticket per person, winner picks snack or sticker. 

sasha: remote friends can join via Steam Remote Play Together; i'll post the lobby link 10 minutes before start. 

taylor: ok plan: search at 6:30, set up 7, raffle 8, start games 8:15. Who's bringing which game? quick list pls. 

ben: i'll bring: "Overcooked 2", "Cuphead" 

rina: "Streets of Rage 4" and a co-op indie surprise 

sasha: I'll queue up a few Steam co-op lobbies (will DM links) 

taylor: perfect. If dock shows up earlier we can cancel raffle. Either way, snacks provided. See you all! :party_popper:
